    • getLabel

      public String getLabel()
      Description copied from interface: FileStore
      The label is a mechanism to distinguish multiple file stores in a single file. For instance, UniDOS has two file stores in the file, so it would have two different labels such as "Disk 1" and "Disk 2".
      Specified by:
